name: Preview Link
description: Allows anyone to preview unpublished content with a unique link.
project_description:
Provides a preview link that is tokenised, and therefore bypasses access control to allow any user to view the latest revision of an entity.

 Versions 
 8.x-1.x is unsupported. 

 If you are still on this branch, please upgrade to 2.1.0-alpha3 first and run the upgrade path. 

 2.x 

Version 2 is a substantial refractor. An upgrade path is added, however if you have custom code integrations its likely you'll need to update to the new API's.

 The currently supported release is 2.2.x, compatible with Drupal 10.2 and 11, and requires PHP 8.1.
